title: Commutativity of the tensor product of modules, natural in both factors
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring. For $R$-modules $M,N$ there is an $R$-linear isomorphism $\tau_{M,N}:M\otimes_RN\to N\otimes_RM$ [def-weil-pbc-module-tensor-product] with $\tau_{M,N}(m\otimes n)=n\otimes m$, and it is natural: for $R$-linear maps $f:M\to M'$ and $g:N\to N'$, $\tau_{M',N'}\circ(f\otimes g)=(g\otimes f)\circ\tau_{M,N}$.
